_about: Corpus for scripts/checker-r-truth-check.mjs (plan item 13 part 2, sub-item B). Made-up data and generic labels. Each script saves with ggsave(width, height) so the canvas is known to both sides. `elements` names the claim that owns the comparison of each class the REAL plot draws (scripts/truth/gg_truth.R): C = control (base_size = N in theme_*(), or a theme() size for an element in the table, which the checker reads: source within 0.05 pt, verdict equal, or exit 2); TEXT = a size set on theme(text = element_text(size =)), TITLE = on theme(title = ...), POS = base_size given positionally (theme_bw(6)), RCAP = the caption, which ggplot2 draws at rel(0.8) of base_size. '-' = drawn, not scored. F (the fix leaves a listed element below its minimum: theme() after theme_*()), L, W1 and GEOMTEXT (an in-panel text drawn with no warning shown) need no entry. Fix 13b (record docs/fixes/13b-checker-sizes.md; ids rc-*, the confirmer's partition): owners R-ORDER (theme_set, theme() and complete themes in order), R-POS, R-TEXT (theme_update(text =)), R-STRIP (strip.text.x alone), R-CANVAS (ggsave scale = and a size written as arithmetic; also `scaleClaim`, which makes the scale comparison a claim instead of the C control), R-FIXPLACE (where the fix lands), D-LOWER (the one-number advice). `base` is the base_size of the complete theme ggplot2 uses for the plot (11 when the script sets none): claim SNIPLOW compares the page's 'Or change one number: base_size = N' with it. Fix 13b review round 1 (ids r1-*): owners R1-UPDATE, R1-UNKNOWN, R1-VOID, R1-GGSAVE; gg_truth.R now calls the real ggsave() with the arguments as bound, so a corrected script real ggsave() rejects does not run. Fix 13b review round 2 (ids r2-*, the reviewer's scripts that found defects; R's built-in datasets in some): owners R2-NAMES, R2-UNREAD, R2-DEVICE, R2-COMBINE, R2-REPLACE, R2-GUIDE; gg_truth.R measures a gtable and the plots inside a cowplot or gridExtra figure by their own cells, and a plot printed to a png() or pdf() device. Fix 13b review round 3 (ids r3-*, the reviewer's scripts that found defects, and siblings; record section 9): owners R3-NAMES (R15, a theme held in a name), R3-UNREAD (every row resting on an unread base floored), R3-DEVICE (a device's plot drawn on a line of its own, grid.arrange(), ragg), R3-COMBINE; gg_truth.R runs a script as Rscript does (autoprint), records grid.arrange() and ragg's devices, and closes the device at dev.off().
